about: Lane E2-STACK2: the Telegram archive's line reader on tg_poll (lib/core tg_archive_engine.cpp).

impossible_cycles.why: tg_archive_engine.cpp: streamLines only calls the line callback its own file passes (forEachLine's wrapper, forEachLineUntil's caller in the same file such as Archive::indexHas); lib/core never holds a device callback, so it never reaches orchestrator chatFor's lambda, which the gate matched by signature alone
